about_the_game:
Tap with Ease, Keep the Beat!

Wacky Themes, Endless Fun!

BackSlap is a 1K quirky rhythm idle game featuring hilarious themes like spa massages, panda karaoke, and otter clam-smashing, delivering a lighthearted and joyful gaming experience.

Fun Themes, Massive Music Library

●  Diverse Themes : Unlock absurd scenarios—spa massages, panda karaoke, otter clam-smashing, and more!

●  Huge Song Collection : Each theme comes with unique tracks and skins—90 songs to keep you hooked!

Simple Taps, One-Key Hide

●  Single-Key Play : Easy 1-track gameplay—use your keyboard or mouse to tap along!

●  Adjustable Difficulty : Choose Gentle Tap (casual) or Hard Smack (hardcore) modes.

●  Boss Key : Customize a one-key hide feature for seamless "work mode" camouflage.

Idle & Level Up

●  Progress Unlocks : Gain EXP by tapping—unlock new themes effortlessly!

●  AFK Listening : Earn EXP while idle with background music—level up while you chill!

Challenge & Compete

●  Leaderboards : Check your ranking after completing songs!

●  Daily Challenges : Random daily trials—aim for the high score!

Jump into BackSlap and start your whimsical rhythm adventure today!
